And behold, these aforementioned kings that remain below, in the secret of the public domain, are nourished and sustained only from this aforementioned Kav, and this is the secret of the Kav of carobs, that the kings remained destroyed and dry, in the secret of "and the former kings died," mentioned in Sefer HaPardes, first chapter; but from the name itself they cannot be nourished. And behold, the filling of the gematria of Elokim, to allude to the aforementioned kings, who are called Elokim, the secret of the judgments, and therefore they are nourished only from the filling, which is the gematria of Elokim, which equals the gematria of 102, as above.

And behold, on the day of Shabbat it is forbidden to carry in the public domain, which is the domain of these aforementioned kings. And behold, it is necessary that they be nourished and that sustenance be brought out to them from the private domain, which is ZA after the correction. And Rabbi Meir holds that ZA, when it is in the phase of the amputee alone, then goes out with its Kav into the public domain, there, to nourish them; and since only the phase of the aforementioned Kav goes out, it is therefore also called an amputee, because the name itself was amputated and ascended above, but only its Kav, which is its filling, is what goes out to nourish in the public domain.
